verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores the whole vault as non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files on the user's device and explicitly says you can switch to another app easily (obsidian-docs-2, obsidian-docs-20, obsidian-docs-23), so there is no lock-in and no export step is needed. Community users corroborate that their notes outlive the app and that they own their files (obsidian-comm-19, obsidian-comm-20, obsidian-comm-3), and Canvas files use an open, MIT-licensed JSON format (obsidian-comm-14). Missing for 10: evidence of how Obsidian-specific constructs (internal links, Bases views, Canvas JSON) carry over cleanly into other apps, and any hands-on account of actually migrating out of Obsidian.
